purpose: Teach: 挙式/原宿/マフィア/マドリード/ハローワーク/フェラーリ/軽井沢/種子

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、教会で挙式されたんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer had their wedding ceremony at a church, Aoi tells me.
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. Gentle delivery — sharing something intimate she learned. A moment of noticing. Warm and unhurried.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、原宿でショッピングがご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer loves shopping in Harajuku, Mei mentioned.
lines.style: Quiet reflection. Trading the detail back like a small gift. Unhurried pace. The tone of someone genuinely curious about the customer's life.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、海外マフィア映画にお詳しいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer is quite knowledgeable about international mafia films, apparently.
lines.style: Slight rise in pitch — a small note of amusement at this detail. Still thoughtful. Conversational, like sharing something unexpectedly specific.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新婚旅行でマドリードに行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer went to Madrid for their honeymoon, Mei said.
lines.style: Warm, almost dreamy quality. Speaking from a place of noticing romance. Unhurried, gentle. The voice of someone who remembers what matters to people.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ハローワーク経由で転職されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer found their new job through the employment office.
lines.style: Thoughtful, grounded delivery. The tone shifts slightly — practical details matter too. Still warm, but noting the effort it took.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、フェラーリを見に行かれるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer goes to see Ferraris, Mei said.
lines.style: Light, almost smiling quality — finding delight in this specific passion. Relaxed pacing. The warmth of knowing what makes someone light up.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、軽井沢の別荘へ夏に行かれるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer has a villa in Karuizawa and goes there in summer.
lines.style: Slower, more reflective. A note of quiet observation — noticing how much life someone has. Gentle, not envious. Trailing slightly on the final thought.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お庭で野菜の種子を蒔かれるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer plants vegetable seeds in their garden, Mei tells me.
lines.style: Soft, intimate ending. Quietest moment of the exchange. The voice of someone noticing care and patience in small things. Gentle fade.
